audience: marketing and sales teams that run webinars in GoTo Webinar

useCases.title: Find upcoming webinars and their registration counts
useCases.text: List the webinars that start in a date range, then open one to see its times, registration URL and registrant count.

useCases.title: Check who registered and who is approved
useCases.text: List the registrants of a webinar with their status: waiting, approved or denied. Open one registrant to read all captured fields.

useCases.title: Review attendance and engagement after a webinar
useCases.text: List the sessions of a webinar, then read the attendance and engagement figures for all sessions. List the people who attended.

useCases.title: Find the recordings and presenters of a webinar
useCases.text: List the recording assets of a webinar and its panelists.

useCases.title: Register a person for a webinar
useCases.text: Read the registration fields of a webinar, then register one person. GoTo emails the person a confirmation unless the organizer turned that off.

useCases.title: Schedule a single-session webinar
useCases.text: Schedule one webinar for the organizer. Give the times in ISO 8601 UTC. The webinar is visible, but no registrant email is sent.
